The remaining slanted constraints on the center segment follow from 3(1-r+r²) >= (1-r)(1+r)^3, strictly true by independent extremum bounds. A 466-assertion verifier checks facet incidence, LP radii and representative centers without asserting infinite exhaustiveness.

value.rationale: The fixed 14-triangle combinatorial family is singled out naturally by the global 9-vertex inscribed-volume theorem. Its inradius-optimal parameter is distinct from the published volume-optimal parameter, and the entire center locus makes a genuine 2D-to-0D-to-1D transition, with eight coincident facet contacts only at the radius maximizer. These sharp geometric features are not face-count deductions, isolated parameter substitutions or arbitrary numerical tabulations; they quantify metric tradeoffs for a canonical ninefold coordination polyhedron.
